answer_1.quote: FollowBench consists of 820 meticulously curated instructions from over 50 NLP tasks, including both closed-and open-ended questions.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text responses adhering to multi-level constraints

answer_2.quote: For evaluation purposes, we propose a hybrid evaluation method comprising rule-based and model-based solutions... The rule-based solutions focus on closed-ended instructions...

answer_3.quote: we propose to develop a model-based approach by using strong LLMs as judges... we propose a Multilevel-aware prompt template...

answer_4.quote: we ask three expert-level human labelers to assess whether the model's response satisfies all the constraints in each case and use the majority voting as the final human annotations.
answer_4.guideline: assess whether the model's response satisfies all the constraints in each case
